blocking.issue: An open panel does not update when replies arrive. Only key-check completion and settings actions call refresh(); _process() updates only the age label. The spend text/bar, reply dots and header ring remain stale until the player reopens the panel or changes a setting.

blocking.issue: Timeout and service-down cancellations never increment fail_streak. AiBridge emits these as {type:cancel,reason:timeout|service_down}, without status:error. Three actual failed outcomes can therefore leave the badge saying live even while every recent dot is a failure.
blocking.evidence: Headless probe emitted three production-shaped timeout cancellations: state=live, fail_streak=0, last_three=[false,false,false]. The existing badge test injects only status:error outcomes.
blocking.requested_change: Include failed cancel outcomes in the consecutive-failure calculation, retaining the specified off/ceiling/problem/working/live precedence and success reset. Test three cancels and mixed error/cancel sequences.

blocking.issue: A completed check is associated only with the provider, not the key that was tested. Replace/Remove remain enabled during a check, erase the current result, and then poll() unconditionally installs the old worker's result. A replacement key can be labelled rejected (or working) based on the previous key.
blocking.evidence: Headless probe started a delayed rejected check, removed the old key, saved a different fixture key, then awaited completion: saved_new_suffix=•••• 5678, card_status=rejected, badge=problem.
blocking.requested_change: Version key-check requests and invalidate pending results on key save/removal, or otherwise prevent a result from being applied to a different key. Add the replacement/removal-during-check regression case.
criteria: V3 result lifetime and removal semantics
